title: Corrective fix for B-77482551: Shared Format Tests And Fixtures
description:

Remaining work: Run the targeted SwiftPM test commands for `MealPlanParserTests`, `AisleConfigParserTests`, and `ShoppingListParserTests` in an environment where SwiftPM manifest execution is permitted, then resolve any runtime or compile failures they expose. If package-level Xcode testing is required, it needs a usable package/project invocation path outside this sandbox. Confirm how to handle the spec-vs-fixture aisle section count mismatch before treating the aisle suite as final.
